_doc: THE MIGRATION DIRECTION DECLARED ONCE, ONE SIGNED SHIFT OF THE CONSTRUCTION-AND-WIRING WAVE'S WRITER LANE W0, ODQ §934.105 (the cloud chair signs by the owner's delegation of 2026-11-06, vetoable; a successor chair does not inherit this signature; the chair's ruling R-W7 (e), docs/chair/2026-11-07/WIRING-RULINGS-2026-11-07.md). THE CAUSE, ONE (commit 343bd4eec on lane/wiring-w0-2026-11-07, its parent the rung-1 candidate 76febf9b0, whose goldens are green): stress[].direction in {arrivals, departures} is written once on the mass_migration entry where the stressor is drawn (stressGenerator.js :: buildStressEntry, no draw; arrivals at birth, the §934.101 direction, because the stressor is drawn at step 4 before any economy exists), and every surface that says which way people move reads it: the crisis text, the entry's viabilityNote half, the pressure line, the Power vignette and its stability label, the newcomers' faction, the crisis secret pool (its one departures secret filtered out of an arrivals record's draw), the spine phrases, the food multiplier; config-only readers read the projection config.migrationDirection stamped by stressConfirmPass. THE CHECK FIRST: coh:migration-direction over the soak 1,000, 45 settlements -> 0 (cert:* 0 -> 0, every other coh:* unchanged). THE MOVE, MEASURED before the write at the stage (the tree of 343bd4eec with the door paths carried from the branch; nothing reverse-applied: the step is this one cause): the espionage fence's driven corpus 6 of 360 rows (thorp 1: SUBw4-fence1-thorp-crossroads-010; village 2: -village-road-002, -village-crossroads-009; city 2: -city-port-002, -city-crossroads-006; metropolis 1: -metropolis-isolated-005; the corpus's mass_migration places: their record gains the direction and the config projection, their stability label names the one direction, their arrivals vignette replaces the departures one where the economy scored under 50, and their crisis secret draws from the arrivals pool), 360/360 distinct, 68c107c2.. -> 1bb9e7a2..; the generator golden master 0 of 525 (no golden config draws mass_migration); the herald desk 0 of 435; every other registered suite green at the stage. NEW WORDS (the owner's veto class; no birth record carries departures, so none prints today): the departures crisis text, three departures pressure lines, the stability label 'Strained (people leaving)' (the arrivals label 'Strained (people arriving or leaving)' -> 'Strained (people arriving)'), the spine pair 'a departure of people it cannot spare' / 'being among the last ones left'; verbatim in docs/WIRING_W0_2026-11-07.md.
